shared_elements: human/deity figures shown frontally or in profile in a register
carved relief signs and symbols in low relief
vertical elongated forms flanking a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief symbolic signs including disc-like circles and an upper zone with a spreading curved/winged motif above smaller figures, which is the most specific correspondence available. Otherwise A is a rectangular field densely filled with many horizontal lines of small script-like signs beneath a register of standing figures, while B is a three-dimensional standing body with a small number of large emblem-like signs on the torso and no writing or registers, so the organisation and content differ fundamentally.
